india.one_line: Indian judiciary, defense, and academia see new AI initiatives spanning legal guidelines, naval training, and research funding.

themes.title: CJI urges AI legal research guidelines
themes.text: Chief Justice Surya Kant called for model guidelines regarding AI assistance disclosure in legal research, while noting limitations in detection software.

stories.headline: CJI Surya Kant urges AI disclosure guidelines for legal research

themes.title: Google funds IIT Kharagpur AI research
themes.text: Google committed $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research across Indic languages, materials science, agriculture, and educational technology.

stories.headline: Google announces $5M funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research

themes.title: Indian Navy officers train on LLMs
themes.text: Parshu Tactical Defence conducted a workshop at INS Valsura where Indian Navy officers trained and deployed fine-tuned language models.

stories.headline: Parshu Tactical Defence trains Indian Navy officers in LLM fine-tuning
